answer: In an agent marketplace for pigment testing, charge a nonrefundable fee for every bid, not every account. Validators accept a bid only with a unique payment receipt bound to its auction and reject reused receipts. A thousand aliases must therefore pay for a thousand bids. Keep a minimum fee even when demand reaches its nadir: a cheap identity is not a cheap spam signal. This limits flooding by a fixed budget, but cannot prove unique owners or stop a well-funded attacker.
